notes.title: Season 2 Episode 3: May News.
notes.notes:
Hello, IoM people! 👋 Today, I have some news and images from episode 3 of season 2.

Here are some general points about the next update:

1) You will be able to choose whether or not to continue the story with Bruce.
2) The coffee shop's functionality will be expanded. John's door will be interactive. ☕
3) The way the gym works will be completely changed.
4) I'm working on adding repeatable scenes. (For example, like the scene that was added to the nightclub in the last update.)

I would also like to inform you that I have built a new PC so I can work faster, but I think I will only use it starting with S2E4, because I don't want to interrupt my progress now. This new PC will help me make the animations faster, which is very important, since animations are what take the most time in development and, as you all know, I love adding lots of animations to the story. 🤩

Speaking of animations, the next update will include many. I still have a lot to develop, but I can assure you that the content will be very good. 🙂😈

My intention is to post once a month here on Steam. Since I was unable to post in April, this time, I am adding more images to this post, which will have 14 images from the next episode.

The new start menu is already done, and I'll post it on my Instagram for anyone who wants to see it.

Now let's take a look at the pictures!

notes.title: Season 2 Episode 3 | March News.
notes.notes:
Hello people! The fate of IoM is not 100% defined; I create the story as I go along, so although I have a general idea, it changes depending on how the game develops and the feedback I receive from the community.

I receive ideas practically every day from Steam and other platforms. It is impossible to implement all the ideas because everyone has different ideas, and there are many of them. However, I always like to read them to get a different perspective. If I like an idea (or part of it) and see that it fits well with the story, then I bring it to the game.

However, there is another case that rarely happens, in which many people ask me for the same thing. I have received dozens of messages from people who would like Bruce's path to be optional (It's a fancy way of putting it because they'd rather have him buried 5 meters underground, hehe), as there are quite a few people who don't like this character. Therefore, in S2E3, there will be the option of making Bruce's path optional, and you will decide. 😏

This is one of the ways in which you, as a community, can affect and/or modify the development of IoM. I love being able to interact with the community 😍, and although it is difficult to keep up with all the messages I receive, I do my best. 🙂

Therefore, S2E3 can have three different beginnings, here is an image of each one:

1) Innocence path: In which Jennifer is talking with Mike.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42345436/4dc61be55547d64497f57e155639ab97a6df0ed3.png[/img]

2) Money path - Refuse getting inside the car: Jennifer refuses to get in the car with Bruce.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42345436/11d54b321b7623996fa709f8298cbd5982a4ff7a.png[/img]

3) Money path - Getting inside the car: Jennifer will decide to hop into his car... What adventures await our lovely Jen if she decides to do this? 😲😈

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42345436/bfa8df790825dc4bb779aa83bb81b187bfb0775f.png[/img]

I wish you all a great week! 👋

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42345436/1c0fe31a00dd57457fcad9c72a897e05809c65bd.png[/img]

The agenda will indicate today's day with a gold triangle symbol so Jennifer will know which customers are coming. It will have the customer's name, a photo, and the "level of service" or "level of progress"; it will be represented with a 1 to 5-star system. Being 1 the lowest type of service and 5 the highest. (I think I don't have to explain what will happen when the service gets higher... 😂)

*** As I said previously, this is a prototype, and you may see some changes in its final version.

The amount of work for this agenda is huge For S2E2, Vicky plans to bring back various of Jennifer's previous customers, so you will see more customers while I make more progress. The possibilities are endless! Each customer will have its own progress, and just look at the amount of customers that can fit the agenda... This is becoming like a game inside a game. 😅

This will take IoM more steps towards an open-world game because the events here will be repeatable, and most of them entirely optional. If a quest gets activated, then it's possible that the day will be different, but while there are no specific quests available, Jennifer will be able to go to the massage center on different days and give customers a "massage."

The progress with the clients will be progressive, and I will always try to include in each update more adventures/progress, but there is so much to do here that I have to measure well the time I will dedicate to the massage center because there is so much to do that it can take many months and it can also slow down the updates. I plan to have several of the old clients coming back in S2E2, and I will try to make at least a little progress with each one. In the future, more customers can appear, and even more stories can be unfolded. 🤩

I'm both excited and scared about the amount of work the massage center will take 😅, but in the end, I'm sure it will be great, and you will love it! 😍😍😍

Before anyone asks, there is still no estimated date for the launch. There is a lot of progress, but I still have a long way to go. I will keep you informed when a date gets closer. 

I wish everyone a fantastic weekend!!! 🍺

notes.title: Season 2 Episode 1 is available!
notes.notes:
Hello people! I am writing to inform you that it took about a month, but finally, the release of the first episode of the second season on Steam was approved! However, the game launch will not be as I expected or wanted, and it may affect the future of the updates here, I explain below:

A) I was not allowed to release the game as early access, and this brings a lot of inconvenience. To make it early access, they asked me for all the adult content of the whole season to review it, which I don't find sense (I don't have it, I have only developed episode 1, isn't that the point of early access?). Because of this, the solution they offered me was to sell each episode as DLC. This is not what I wanted and makes everything much more complex. If it were early access, I would just put a price to the game, and every time I had an update, with a simple click of a button, I would make everyone get updated, however, being DLC, each DLC has to be approved by Steam so it will bring more delays to the launch, plus I have to create each episode as DLC, put a price, it is also more uncomfortable for the players, etc... I have seen many games of this style that are as early access, I don't understand why they don't allow me to do it? But to be able to publish it, I have to do what they tell me.

B) Season 2 of the game comes with a new music player and 100% original songs; I have the whole soundtrack of the game I published on Spotify, and in the game, I had put different buttons that lead to my Spotify page. However, for the Steam version, I was asked to remove all the buttons that went to Spotify, so I removed all the buttons on the start menu, Jennifer's smartphone, the music player itself, etc. (After removing these, I retested the entire game to see that everything worked fine).

C) I had to change the name of the game from:
"Innocence Or Money | Season 2". 
To:
"Innocence Or Money | Season 2 | Episode 1".

I decided to do this myself so that players would not get confused and know precisely what they are buying.

D) I modified the Steam page of the game, you will see that it no longer says early access, and all the texts that appeared indicating this have been removed.

E) The game had a special set of texts at the end for Steam players explaining how the early access would work, all of that changed, so I also removed that from the game.

F) The price of the game will also change, I will release episode 1 with a much lower price and then price the different DLCs.

To be honest... I'm quite frustrated with this release, I love the content of episode 1 of season 2, and I'm sure the vast majority will like it, but the changes necessary to be able to release the game are frustrating and, in my opinion, unfair as you don't have to look far to find games of this style that are early access, however they have made it much more complex and uncomfortable for me. At one point, I thought about stopping the launch here, but I know there are a lot of people here waiting for the game and encouraging me to get it.

Creating each episode as DLC and waiting for each one to be approved before being released results in a lot of extra work and delays in the releases. What I once said that the releases would be done on all platforms together will no longer be done. I hope you understand the reason for this. It's very unfair that other people have to wait because of all this.

I hope to be able to release each episode here, but if I see that there are too many delays and the process takes too long, maybe I will have to group episodes together and do fewer releases; I don't know at the moment what I will do. It should be a moment of joy as I will finally be able to post the first episode of the second season here for everyone to enjoy and continue with the story; however, due to this whole situation, I am more frustrated than happy... But what else can I say... I hope you at least like this first episode of the second season.

Something that worried people on the forums here was if the content of the game is changed, rest assured that all the normal story content is included, the needed changes were more on a technical aspect, and since I made the Steam store page in +20 languages I had to change all the stores.

I told everyone on the forums that I was going to do my best to post the first episode here, and I've kept my word, here it is. 😉

I wish a great weekend to everyone!

notes.title: Innocence Or Money | Season 2 Launch has been Denied :(
notes.notes:
It is with deep sadness that I write to all of you to inform you that the release of season 2 here has been denied.

There are many months of work and preparation to make this release happen, you can't even imagine how disappointed I am at this point. 

In order to make the launch I am required to make some changes to make the game adhere to all the guidelines and regulations of the platform, and this, I don't know how long it will take me, I will do everything I can for you, the IoM community on Steam is huge and season 1 was a success, I know there are many people waiting to play season 2, but due to this setback the delay could be weeks or months.

I write this message with a lot of frustration and without much encouragement, but I know that there are many people waiting for the game here and I think it is very important that everyone is informed, after all, the game exists thanks to the players and the community. Please know that I will keep doing my best to bring the game to Steam because this community deserves it, but I can't say when it will be available because that won't depend only on me.

notes.title: Innocence Or Money: Season 2 - Steam page creation this week!
notes.notes:
Hello people! 👋 This will be a long post, so get your popcorn and get comfortable! 😎

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42345436/963ff684cbd7e0bba70ebdf6ce5a573057f28927.png[/img]

First off, I need to extend my sincerest apologies for the radio silence over the past month here on Steam. If you've reached out via Steam messages or the forums and haven't heard back, or if you've sent me a friend invite that's gathered virtual dust, I'm truly sorry. I'm not inactive, far from it—I’m laser-focused on game development, and sadly that has left me with little to no time to respond. I appreciate your understanding and patience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42345436/443f8f61162fbbdfd1bff5096196ca03a2f26b01.png[/img]

But today, I come bearing exciting news! 🤩

Season 2, Episode 1 is on the cusp of completion! I've taken your feedback to heart, especially concerning the pacing of Season 1's release. Unlike last time, where Episode 3 dropped on Steam and everyone was left waiting for what felt like eons for the entire season to be available, I’m shaking things up.

I'm thrilled to announce that Season 2 will debut as an "early access" title. Those who jump in early will get to experience each episode hot off the press as they are completed. It's a way to keep the adventure going without the lengthy intermissions!

In addition, many of you know that Innocence Or Money (IoM) is available across multiple platforms. There have been occasions when a release has hit another platform before Steam (no specifics mentioned to keep the peace with community guidelines hehe 😅), but that's changing. From now on, simultaneous releases are the new norm! Every platform will receive updates concurrently, same day, same hour. This way, I make sure no one is left out and everyone can dive into the IoM universe together, no matter the platform. 😍

This week I will be creating the Steam store page and I will also send the game for approval, the current status of Season 2 Episode 1 is the following: 

--- GAME STATUS ---

[b]IMAGES:[/b] 1.686 (100% Finished)
[b]ANIMATIONS:[/b] 503!!! 🤩 (100% Finished)
I pushed myself to reach this number; now we have more cameras than Fred! 😎🎥
[b]TEXT/STORY:[/b] 100% Finished
[b]CODING:[/b] 95% Finished
[b]TRANSLATIONS:[/b] 25% Finished
[b]SOUNDS:[/b] 20% FInished

The game code has been modified from the core, and episode 1 of the second season is a base on which I will be able to build and develop many new things and take the IoM world to a new level. In the following months, a lot of new functionalities will be added during the development of Season 2.

---

Let's go with some pics and information.

[b]2 New languages will be added:[/b]
* Arabic
* Spanish (Latin America)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42345436/4c8ef684e4a8354f668f71e7cdd5f0e17db5e6ea.png[/img]

[b]The music player will have some new functionality (This is an old pic, the final one is ready but it's a surprise, so I'm not showing it 😉)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42345436/babfd0075bf3d5bf26be38b68fffb72d3f9b9c3d.png[/img]

[b]The floors of the gym bathrooms were upgraded with anti-slip coatings (Please note only the new floor, there is nothing else to see in this picture...) 😁[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42345436/40d347feb733e56520bc298fe1028554cd125fec.png[/img]

[b]The first episode of season 2 has the corruption/money route as its main focus; however, details of the innocence route have also been worked on, such as Jennifer wearing her first uniform in the cafeteria. (I don't think many will see this image in the game so I'm posting it here 😂)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42345436/417b5b2e022f9827e7360cdfff44f6357b0f02a9.png[/img]

The first episode of season 2 has taken me many months of development, but I am satisfied with the content and it is in the final stretch, once Steam approves it I will inform you all to start the countdown to launch!

Make sure you read the whole story and go through the quests, if you don't, you might miss a scene like this one that is already included in the game... [b](HUGE SPOILER COMING!!!)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42345436/89725cf15c0b1a6a2f916815f4fb92dcc4744f5e.png[/img]

🤩🤩🤩

I hope soon to be announcing the good news of the launch 🚀, I wish you all a great week and again I apologize for not answering the messages (dm / forum / invitations), I think I won't be able to answer them until the game is launched. Thanks to everyone! See ya! 👋

Hello people! I inform you that Innocence or Money will have many changes on Steam from now on, I will summarize below everything that is coming!
